propositions: rebar must support s3://bucket/prefix URLs as sync.remote values for ticket-store git history with SSE-KMS encryption, without storing data in GitHub, while preserving init/create/claim/push/fetch workflows
when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below minimum version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install

concurrent or legacy pushes can leave multiple <sha>.bundle files for a single ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and making fresh clones fail; this multi-bundle state must self-heal non-interactively by merge, preserving all commits/events from all divergent heads
optional s3 backend must be documented with dependency installation, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket setup, IAM configuration, and sync.remote=s3://… usage
